Class Player

java.lang.Object
item.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Player>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, CPUPlayer
public class Player extends Object implements Comparable<Player>
Represents a Player in the game. A Player has a name, tokens, reserved Cards, production levels, nobles who visited them, and points.
